fusions.name: Riding Down
fusions.desc: Charges up to 7 tiles to the target and rides it down, dealing 15 damage and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. For 4 seconds after using it, you move 20% faster.

fusions.name: Loosed Reins
fusions.desc: Lets a rein-length cord fly at an enemy up to 8 tiles away, dealing 30 damage, up to 1.6 times as much at full reach. It is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Full Tack
fusions.desc: Raises your movement speed by 40% and your dodge chance by 10% for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Saddle Rhythm
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
